_about: Numeric test conditions that PSI record text states outright. Curated by hand from data/psi_combustion_records.csv. Every quote must appear verbatim (whitespace-normalized) in the named CSV field, or `npm run data` fails. Values are copied exactly as stated; atm values are converted to psia at build time (1 atm = 14.696 psia).
